components.name: Atmosphère
components.about: Custom firmware. Brings the homebrew menu, Daybreak for firmware updates, haze for USB file transfer and reboot_to_payload.

components.name: hekate
components.about: Bootloader and boot menu. A modchip starts payload.bin; Atmosphère's reboot-to-payload starts hekate too.

components.name: sys-patch
components.about: Signature patches as a sysmodule, needed to install and run anything not signed by Nintendo.

components.name: DBI (English)
components.about: Installer and title manager: installs from the SD card, over USB (MTP) and from a PC, dumps your own titles.

components.name: Goldleaf
components.about: File browser, installer and title manager; pairs with Quark on a PC for USB installs.

components.name: sphaira
components.about: Homebrew menu with a file browser, installer and homebrew store.

components.name: CyberFoil
components.about: NSP/NSZ/XCI/XCZ installer from SD, USB and network libraries.

components.name: Awoo Installer
components.about: NSP/NSZ/XCI/XCZ installer. TinWoo is an archived fork of it.

components.name: JKSV
components.about: Save backup and restore; backups land in /JKSV.

components.name: Checkpoint
components.about: Alternative save manager.

components.name: ftpd
components.about: FTP server for Wi-Fi file transfer. Its last release predates firmware 21 and may crash; sphaira has FTP built in.

components.name: AIO Switch Updater
components.about: On-console updater. Dormant since 2023 apart from a 2025 rebuild, and it also fetches firmware from third parties; switchsd does the updating from a PC instead.

components.name: Homebrew App Store
components.about: Store for homebrew apps. This is the rebuild its maintainers point to until 2.4 is out: the official 2.3.2 predates firmware 21's ABI and crashes on exit there.

components.name: EdiZon overlay
components.about: Cheats from the overlay menu (L + D-pad down + R3 > EdiZon > Cheats).

components.name: Breeze
components.about: Cheat manager and memory search, with its own overlays. Every release is marked as a pre-release, so the newest one is taken.

components.name: Ultrahand overlay menu
components.about: The overlay menu, including nx-ovlloader, that the other overlays run in.

components.name: sys-clk
components.about: Clock control per game, with sys-clk manager. Do not overclock a Switch Lite: its battery and cooling are made for stock clocks.

components.name: sys-clk overlay (Ultrahand build)
components.about: Newer sys-clk overlay that matches the Ultrahand menu.

components.name: Status Monitor Deux
components.about: Clocks, temperatures, battery and FPS on screen; replaces the archived Status Monitor overlay.

components.name: QuickNTP
components.about: Sets the clock from an NTP server; Nintendo's time server is blocked under CFW.

components.name: Sysmodules overlay
components.about: Switches sysmodules such as SaltyNX or sys-con on and off from the overlay menu.

components.name: SaltyNX
components.about: Plugin loader that FPSLocker and Status Monitor's FPS counter need. Installed switched off, because it loads into every game: set Auto Start in the Sysmodules overlay and reboot to use it.

components.name: FPSLocker
components.about: Per-game frame rate limits; needs SaltyNX switched on.

components.name: MissionControl
components.about: PlayStation, Xbox and other Bluetooth controllers work like Nintendo ones.

components.name: Disable remap dialog
components.about: Home menu patches that drop the dialog shown whenever button remapping is active. From MissionControl's author; its own repository is archived and this one carries the patches on.

components.name: sys-con
components.about: Wired USB controllers from other consoles. Starts at boot.

components.name: ldn_mitm
components.about: Local-wireless multiplayer over LAN. Built for one Atmosphère version, so it is pinned together with it.

components.name: Switch 90DNS tester
components.about: Checks that Nintendo's servers are blocked before you go online under CFW.

components.name: NXThemes Installer
components.about: Installs custom home menu themes.

components.name: Theme patches
components.about: Home menu patches NXThemes Installer needs for each firmware, in themes/systemPatches where it looks for them.

components.name: Themezer-NX
components.about: Browses and downloads themes from themezer.net.

components.name: emuiibo
components.about: Virtual amiibo; amiibo go in /emuiibo/amiibo.

components.name: Linkalho
components.about: Links a placeholder Nintendo Account offline, for games that ask for one.

components.name: Moonlight
components.about: Streams games from a gaming PC (Sunshine or GeForce Experience) to the Switch.

components.name: green-nx
components.about: Xbox Cloud Gaming client: Game Pass cloud games on the Switch over Wi-Fi.

components.name: Autorun
components.about: Runs your own Windows PC games (Wine with FEX/Box64, DXVK, VKD3D). Experimental. It updates itself, so setup installs it only when it is missing.

components.name: tico
components.about: Emulation frontend: emulators from the NES to the GameCube, Wii, PS2 and 3DS, installed from its own Store. It refuses Album mode, so start it from a game or a forwarder. It updates itself, so setup installs it only when it is missing.

components.name: SysDVR
components.about: Streams the Switch's screen to a PC over USB or Wi-Fi. Starts at boot.

components.name: Battery desync fix
components.about: CTCaer's tool for a battery gauge that has lost track of the real charge, for example after a battery swap.

components.name: sys-botbase
components.about: Remote control over Wi-Fi for `switchsd.py remote`: buttons, touch, screenshots, SD card files. masagrator's build, because upstream's 4.5 MB heap crashes firmware 21 and newer (error 0x10801). Installed switched off: turn it on in the Sysmodules overlay only while you use it, because anyone on the network can then control the console and read its card.

components.name: TegraExplorer-Ext
components.about: hekate payload: file manager outside Horizon; scripts/FirmwareDump.te dumps the console's own firmware for Daybreak.

components.name: KitNX
components.about: hekate payload from the HATS author: network block and theme removal from outside Horizon, and a modified Atmosphère package3 that Tinfoil needs. Each release fits one Atmosphère version.

components.name: Fizeau
components.about: Screen colour temperature and filters. Starts at boot.

components.name: NX-Shell
components.about: File manager; this fork is rebuilt for current firmware.

components.name: NX-Activity-Log
components.about: Play time per game.
